ozonometer: An instrument for ascertaining the amount of ozone in the atmosphere, or in any gaseous mixture. Faraday.
ozena: A discharge of fetid matter from the nostril, particularly if associated with ulceration of the soft parts and disease of the bones of the nose.
ozonepaper: Paper coated with starch and potassium iodine. It turns blue when exposed to ozone.>-- also called starch-iodide paper --> P.
ozonometry: The measurement or determination of the quantity of ozone.
ozonizer: An apparatus or agent for the production or application of ozone.
ozonic: Pertaining to, resembling, or containing, ozone.
ozonification: The act or process of producing, or of subjecting to the action of, ozone.
ozonometric: Pertaining to, or used for, the determination of the amount of ozone; of or relating to ozonometry.
ozonoscopic: Serving to indicate the presence or the amount of ozone.
ozocerite: A waxlike mineral resin; -- sometimes called native paraffin, and mineral wax.
ozonation: The act of treating with ozone; also, the act of converting into, or producing, ozone; ozonization.
ozonoscope: An apparatus employed to indicate the presence, or the amount, of ozone.
ozonize: (a) To convert into ozone, as oxygen. (b) To treat with ozone.
